appliedAnchor.finding: The heritage-entity coordinate identifies Kistefos Træsliberi itself and lies inside the preserved pulp-mill core rather than at a generic visitor information point.

officialIndustrialIdentity.finding: Kistefos documents A/S Kistefos Træsliberi as founded in 1889, in production from 1890 to 1955, and preserved with buildings and production equipment nearly complete.

officialProductionCore.finding: The official museum identifies the old pulp factory as the heart of Kistefos and describes intact machinery and production rooms.

officialVisitorContext.finding: The official address and current museum operations are visitor context, not substitutes for the historic factory anchor.

heritageScope.finding: The protection includes the pulp mill, forge/workshop, boiler house, log-floating installations, saw-house ruin, gardens, former work areas, roads, water and green areas connecting the industrial complex.

independentPhysicalCrossCheck.finding: The geotagged photograph of the pulp mill is approximately 47.9 metres from the retained anchor and provides a physical cross-check.

falseCandidates.finding: The same-name visitor information point is not the historic factory object.
The northern visitor information point does not represent the pulp-mill core.

contractDecision.finding: The coordinate and source identity remain correct. The previous custom role was outside Coordinate Source Contract v1 and is replaced with historical_anchor.

radiusDecision.finding: The radius covers the pulp mill, nearby support buildings and central river and industrial-museum context without claiming the legal protection polygon or the complete art destination.

decision.representationLimit: The marker represents the preserved pulp mill and industrial core. The larger protected environment and modern art destination remain contextual extents.
